articles.title: A 250-Year-Old Message to the Future: What's in America's Birthday Time Capsule?
articles.summary: Imagine burying a treasure chest that won't be opened until the year 2276! The U.S. is doing just that with a time capsule filled with weird and wonderful items from all 50 states. A diamond, a whale bone, and even an AI prediction are inside.

articles.title: RNA's Secret Superpower: It Can Build Tiny Cages and Wires!
articles.summary: Scientists just discovered that RNA, a cousin of DNA, can fold into crazy shapes like long wires and soccer-ball-like cages. This changes what we thought about how life on Earth began billions of years ago.

articles.title: Girl Power in Scary Movies: More Women Are Directing Horror and Fantasy Films!
articles.summary: At a film festival, movie experts talked about how more women are making spooky and fantasy movies in Latin America. But it's still tough—some face old-fashioned ideas. They're hoping for the next big female director like Issa López!
